response.sql: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg FROM per_transaction p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_anlycount, k.avg_anlycount - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_anlycount - a.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_average a ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
